rules: 1 all-in crypto pick per day, 100% deployed
Spot crypto only (BTC, ETH, SOL, and other liquid coins on Robinhood)
Rotate each 6:45am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Hard stop at entry; leverage conviction, protect downside

positions.name: Ethereum
positions.catalyst: THE TEST I WROTE DOWN LAST SESSION FIRED, AND IT FIRED AGAINST THE POSITION I WAS HOLDING. On 2026-08-31 I refused ETH on one explicit, pre-registered condition: 'my written test for owning ETH over BTC was that the ETH/BTC cross must expand, and it has now failed to confirm twice running.' The cross has now expanded: 0.0314212 (8/31) -> 0.0316899 (today), +0.86%. I do not get to ignore my own trigger when it prints. TAPE SINCE MY LAST RUN (2026-08-31T19:50:17Z -> 2026-09-09T00:13:08Z, an unintended 8-DAY hold; the 9/1 through 9/7 rotations did not fire): DOT 0.8377 -> 1.2558 (+49.91%), AVAX 7.216 -> 8.039 (+11.40%), LTC 48.983 -> 54.522 (+11.31%), ADA 0.1995 -> 0.22078 (+10.67%), LINK 11.453 -> 12.56 (+9.67%), DOGE 0.0834 -> 0.09075 (+8.81%), AAVE 124.02 -> 129.45 (+4.38%), XRP 1.391 -> 1.4235 (+2.34%), ETH 2485.25 -> 2493.77 (+0.34%), SOL 103.88 -> 103.77 (-0.11%), BTC 79094.77 -> 78692.84 (-0.51%). Board is 9 green / 2 red and BTC is DEAD LAST. MY BTC THESIS DID NOT JUST FAIL, IT FAILED IN A WAY I DID NOT PRE-SPECIFY. I bought BTC on one argument only -- that it out-defends the board in drawdown -- and I named the invalidation as 'BTC's drawdown matching or exceeding the board median.' There was no drawdown. The board rallied and BTC was the single worst performer on it. Drawdown-defense is worthless in a tape that does not draw down, and I was carrying the lowest-beta seat into the largest alt rotation of the year. The seat had no advantage; it had a cost. ETH IS THE ONLY MAJOR WITH A DATED, INSTITUTIONAL, STILL-ACCELERATING FLOW STORY. U.S. spot ETH ETFs just posted their strongest three-week inflow stretch of 2026: $986.9M in the latest week and $3.8B over the period, with record weekly inflows for a second straight week. Wall Street is rotating into ETH over BTC, and BlackRock's staked ETH product (ETHB) is pulling flow. This is the mirror image of the BTC ETF story that broke on me on 8/28. FLOW/PRICE DIVERGENCE IS THE ASYMMETRY. ETH took $3.8B over three weeks and went up 0.34% in eight days while DOT went up 50% on a short squeeze. Record institutional accumulation into a price that has not moved is the setup I want: the buyer is real, dated and still buying, and I am not paying for the move yet. ETH sits near $2,500 against $2,511-$2,546 resistance with exchange outflows and whale accumulation underneath. WHY NOW AND NOT AFTER THE BINARIES. August CPI prints 9/11 and the FOMC decides 9/16 with hike odds ~57-60%. I am carrying event risk either way because this book must be 100% deployed. Given that, I would rather carry it in the one liquid major whose bid is a documented multi-week institutional allocation than in a coin whose bid was $610K of liquidated shorts.
positions.driver: Closed BTC at 78692.84 (canonical live, asOf 2026-09-09T00:13:08.644Z) vs entry 79094.77 for -61.72 (-0.51%) on 0.153568 units over an 8-day hold. Book capital rolls 12,146.46 -> 12,084.73, still +20.8% on the $10,000 inception. PROCESS FAILURE FIRST: seven consecutive scheduled rotations (9/1 through 9/7) did not execute. This book's entire risk model assumes a daily rotation and a live stop; for eight days it had neither. I got off cheap -- 51bps in the lowest-beta asset on the board -- but the same gap in DOGE or ADA would have been a double-digit unmanaged swing in either direction. Flagging again because this is the second consecutive session opening with missed runs and the gap is getting longer, not shorter. WHY ETH. Three things line up and I want them separated. (1) MY OWN PRE-REGISTERED TRIGGER FIRED. Last session I named exactly one condition for owning ETH -- ETH/BTC expansion -- and refused ETH twice when it failed. It expanded +0.86%. A test only has value if I act on it in both directions. (2) THE FLOW IS DATED, INSTITUTIONAL AND ACCELERATING. $986.9M in the latest week, $3.8B over three weeks, second straight record week, ETHB staked product pulling flow. Contrast with the BTC ETF bid, which flipped to outflows on 8/28 and killed my original reason for holding BTC. (3) IT HAS NOT RUN. ETH is +0.34% over eight days while the board median is roughly +9%. I am buying the accumulation, not the move. WHY NOT BTC AGAIN. Because the argument is now empirically dead, not merely stale. I held BTC solely for drawdown defense and the eight-day window contained no drawdown -- BTC finished last in a 9-of-11 green tape. Capital is rotating OUT of BTC into alts (CoinMarketCap's Altcoin Season Index 27 -> 43, +59% in seven days; alt open interest above BTC open interest for the first time since December 2024). Holding the lowest-beta seat during a documented rotation out of that seat is the opposite of the mandate. WHY NOT DOT, THE +50% PRINT AND THE LOUDEST NAME ON THE BOARD. This is the seductive one and the answer is easy. The move was a 9/5 SHORT SQUEEZE that liquidated ~$610K of shorts -- a mechanical, non-recurring bid, already spent. DOT ran 0.84 -> 1.26 and has already faded off $1.03 intraday highs. The real catalysts (JAM, the March supply-cap cut, Devnet throughput) are undated or already priced. Buying maximum beta at +50% off a spent squeeze, three days before CPI, with a stop I would have to place under an air pocket, is the precise inverse of asymmetric-with-downside-protection. WHY NOT SOL, WHICH AGAIN HAS THE BEST STRUCTURAL STORY. SEC formally recognized SOL alongside BTC and ETH for commodity-based trusts on 9/5, and Alpenglow (12.8s -> ~150ms finality) targets October mainnet. That is genuinely excellent. But SOL ETF inflows COLLAPSED 96% week over week, $153.87M -> $6.18M, with a $5.21M outflow on 9/4 -- and the price is -0.11%, second-worst on the board, through the single best news week it has had. When the SEC blesses your asset class and the money leaves anyway, the flow is telling me something the headline is not. This is now the fourth straight session I have passed on SOL, and I am on record that repeatedly declining a good catalyst is itself a way to be wrong -- but I am declining it this time on ITS OWN flow data, not on my macro view, which is a better reason than I had before. WHY NOT LTC / AVAX / ADA / LINK / DOGE. All up 8.8-11.4% with no comparable institutional bid. LTC's spot ETF (LTCC) holds roughly $5.4M in net assets on 11-16K average daily shares -- that is not an institutional flow story, it is a rounding error, and LTC has now gone from worst-on-board to +11% on rotation beta alone. AVAX and LINK remain catalyst-free. ADA and DOGE are pure high-beta rotation. Every one of these is a lower-quality version of the same alt-rotation bet with worse liquidity and a wider stop. WHY NOT XRP (+2.34%). CLARITY Act still needs Q4. Undated is undated -- unchanged from my last four sessions. SIZING AND RISK BUDGET. Major-tier 8% stop at 2294.2684. 4.845969 units at 2493.77 = $12,084.73 deployed, 100% of book.
positions.risks: I AM BUYING INTO EXTREME GREED THREE DAYS BEFORE CPI. The Crypto Fear & Greed Index is at 80 -- Extreme Greed, the highest reading since December 2024 -- after BTC ran from roughly $64,600 on August 5 to $79,000. Sentiment at this level is a well-known contrarian marker, and I am going 100% long into it with August CPI on 9/11 and an FOMC on 9/16 carrying ~57-60% hike odds. If CPI runs hot, a first-hike-since-2023 repricing hits every coin on this board and ETH's higher beta means I lose more than the BTC seat I just sold. That is the direct cost of this rotation and I am accepting it knowingly. I MAY BE ROTATING AT THE EXACT WRONG MOMENT -- THE CLASSIC LAST-INVESTOR ERROR. The alt rotation is eight days old and well documented (Altcoin Season Index +59% in a week, alt OI above BTC OI). I am joining it after the move, using an eight-day tape I did not trade because my runs failed. Selling the laggard and buying the rotation after the rotation is visible to everyone is how books buy tops. My defense is that ETH specifically has NOT participated (+0.34%), but 'the one that hasn't moved yet' is also how people describe things that are not moving for a reason. MY TRIGGER FIRED BY 86 BASIS POINTS AND THAT IS THIN. The ETH/BTC cross went 0.0314212 -> 0.0316899. I have explicitly warned myself against building a rotation on a sub-noise-band move, and I flagged LTC's +0.08% as 'a rounding error, not relative strength.' 0.86% over eight days is larger than that but it is not a decisive regime signal -- and part of the expansion is simply BTC falling, not ETH rising. I should be honest that my trigger was cleared partly by weakness in the denominator. ETF FLOWS ARE THE THESIS AND ETF FLOWS ARE EXACTLY WHAT BROKE LAST TIME. I bought BTC on an ETF inflow streak on 8/28 and the streak died within the week. I am now buying ETH on an ETF inflow streak. The structure of the argument is identical to the one that just failed me, and the daily prints are already choppy: +$8.6M (9/1), -$48.2M (9/2), +$141.4M (9/3), +$25.9M (9/4). Weekly records built on alternating daily flows are more fragile than the weekly number suggests. THE 8-DAY RUN GAP IS THE LARGEST UNMANAGED RISK IN THIS BOOK AND IT IS NOT A MARKET RISK. Seven straight scheduled rotations did not fire. If that continues, the 8% stop is the only live risk control, and an 8% stop on a higher-beta asset through a CPI print and an FOMC is a wide, slow instrument. I am increasing beta at the same time my rotation discipline is demonstrably not functioning. BENIGN FAILURE MODE: CPI comes in benign, the tape chops into the FOMC, ETH stalls against $2,511-$2,546 resistance and I hold a flat position while DOT-style beta keeps running without me. STRUCTURAL INVALIDATION, STATED IN ADVANCE: (1) the ETH/BTC cross contracts back below 0.03142 -- the trigger unwinds and the seat loses its stated reason; or (2) weekly U.S. spot ETH ETF flows turn NET NEGATIVE -- the accumulation thesis is the whole position and its death is the exit, exactly as I applied that rule to BTC on 8/28. Either one ends this trade regardless of price. Hard stop 2294.2684 (-8%, major-tier).
